title: One-shot exact-base canonical patch executor
goal: Apply a verified patch only to a clean exact-base target workspace using an unconsumed APPLY_READY_NOT_STARTED permit; do not auto-commit.
laws: Target workspace HEAD must exactly equal permit.targetSha.
Target workspace must be clean before apply.
Candidate, permit and patch identities/digests/scopes must agree exactly.
git apply --check must pass before git apply.
Post-apply changed paths must exactly equal permit.changedFiles.
Permit is consumed only after successful bounded apply.
No auto-commit, push, merge, builder invocation, or remote fallback.
Failure leaves permit unconsumed whenever apply did not occur.
